title: A Club Tier Against the Quoted Price of a Vacation Package: the Combinations
content:
The quoted price of a package among the Vacation Package Products may carry a discount on account of a Wanderlane Traveller Club membership held by the traveller. Three particulars of the membership decide it: whether it stands active at a tier carrying a package discount, when that tier took effect measured against the day the deposit was taken, and when its status expires measured against the departure date.

| Membership stands active at a tier carrying a package discount | Tier took effect | Status expiry date | Package discount applied to the quoted price |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| yes | on or before the day the deposit was taken | falls after the departure date | the package discount percentage that tier carries |
| yes | on or before the day the deposit was taken | falls on or before the departure date | that same percentage taken at 50 per cent |
| yes | after the day the deposit was taken | either | nil |
| no | either | either | nil |

**First combination.** Where the traveller holds a club membership standing active whose tier carries a package discount, whose tier took effect on or before the day the deposit was taken and whose status expiry date falls after the departure date, the package discount applied is the package discount percentage that tier carries.

**Second combination.** Where the traveller holds a club membership standing active whose tier carries a package discount, whose tier took effect on or before the day the deposit was taken and whose status expiry date falls on or before the departure date, the package discount applied is that same percentage taken at the expiring-tier share published for this calculation, which is 50 per cent. A tier carrying a package discount of 7 per cent therefore yields 3.5 per cent on such a membership.

**Otherwise.** Where no such membership stands active, where the tier it stands at carries no package discount, or where the tier took effect after the day the deposit was taken, no discount of this kind is applied to the quoted price.

## On the two boundaries

A tier that took effect on the very day the deposit was taken counts as having taken effect on or before that day, and satisfies that limb. A status expiry date falling on the departure date itself falls on or before it, and so belongs to the second combination rather than the first.
